hero.title: NFTs and dApps: build them well and sell them honestly
hero.subtitle: Learn what an NFT really is, write a capped collection with royalties, choose storage that lasts, build a marketplace and a mint page, and plan the money, the rights and the safety. Every task is checked and explained.
hero.outcomeLine: After this course you can plan and build a small NFT project and judge other projects critically.

Pass each module quiz (70% or more). Short tests inside the lessons give instant feedback.
Complete the NFT plan and the final assessment.

faq.q: Does the platform run my contracts or wallet code?
faq.a: No. The labs check your designs, analysis and calculations. You run the code in your own tools on a test network.

faq.q: Is this about making money from NFTs?
faq.a: No. It teaches how NFTs work and how to build and sell them honestly. NFTs can lose all their value, and nothing here is investment advice.
No. Rules differ by country. Take advice from a qualified lawyer before selling anything.

activities.title: Who gets what in a resale?
activities.objective: Split a resale price between the marketplace fee, the creator's royalty and the seller.
activities.scenario: An NFT resells for 200,000 rupees. The marketplace charges 2.5% and the creator's royalty is 5%. Work out the split. (A teaching model.)
steps: In B7 work out the marketplace fee: price times fee percentage over 100.
In B8 work out the creator royalty.
In B9 work out what the seller receives.
In B10 work out the seller's share as a percentage of the price.
In B11 work out the total taken in fees and royalties.

activities.title: What does on-chain storage cost?
activities.objective: Estimate the cost of putting an image on-chain and compare it with pinned off-chain storage.
activities.scenario: A 3,200-byte SVG would be stored on-chain in 32-byte words at about 22,100 gas per new word. Compare with paying a pinning service. (Teaching figures.)
steps: In B7 work out how many 32-byte words are needed, rounding up.
In B8 work out the gas for storing them.
In B9 work out the cost in ETH at the gas price in gwei.
In B10 convert to rupees.
In B11 show On-chain costs more if B10 is above the pinning cost (B6), otherwise On-chain is cheaper.

checks.label: B7 is the words needed
checks.hint: =ROUNDUP(B2/32,0)

checks.label: B8 is the gas
B9 is the cost in ETH
checks.explain: Gas times gwei over a billion.

checks.label: B10 is the cost in rupees
B11 is the verdict
checks.hint: =IF(B10>B6,"On-chain costs more","On-chain is cheaper")
